hints.title: Prefix Driven Decoding Step
hints.text: A one-bit character begins with zero, whereas any two-bit character starts with one, regardless of what follows.

hints.title: Advancing Pointer by Token Length
hints.text: Iterate from the start. Whenever you see a 1, advance by 2 steps. Whenever you see a 0, advance by 1 step.

hints.title: Checking Final Landing Position
hints.text: Loop while index is strictly less than n - 1. If index equals n - 1 after the loop finishes, the final character was decoded alone as a one-bit symbol.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving linear O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full parsing with recursive branching is unnecessary because encoding choices are strictly unambiguous from left to right.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pointer jumping avoids copying or modifying the bits array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice that the leading bit of every character completely determines its length.
